meta.title: Answer the security questionnaire once | nisd2.eu
meta.description: Fill the single supplier security questionnaire once, share with every customer. Structured by ENISA NIS 2 TIG v1.0. Free. Open source.

hero.headline: Answer the security questionnaire once.
hero.subhead: One canonical supplier questionnaire, structured by ENISA NIS 2 Technical Implementation Guidance v1.0. Every question cites CIR 2024/2690, BSIG §30 or BSI IT-Grundschutz. Free. Open source. Your data stays portable.
hero.anchorBadge: Structured by ENISA NIS 2 TIG v1.0 §5

steps.heading: How it works.
steps.lead: Three steps, from first sign-in to first customer invite.

items.title: Create a profile
items.body: Sign in with Google. Enter company name and primary domain. Two minutes.

items.title: Answer the questionnaire
items.body: Identity, contract clauses, cybersecurity measures, technical details. At your own pace. Draft auto-saves.

items.title: Invite customers
items.body: Each invited customer gets a private magic link. No public profile, no search-engine indexing.

sections.heading: What is in the questionnaire.
sections.lead: Ten sections, each citing the underlying paragraph of ENISA TIG, CIR 2024/2690 or BSI IT-Grundschutz.
sections.footnote: The full schema is public on GitHub and exportable as JSON.

preview.heading: Sample questions.
preview.lead: Three questions from the questionnaire, with the help text suppliers see while filling them in.

bsi.quote: We welcome current industry initiatives to develop a unified questionnaire catalogue for suppliers.
bsi.attribution: BSI NIS-2 FAQ (supply chain and security).
bsi.context: This supplier portal IS that industry initiative. A privately built, unified questionnaire catalogue, structured by the canonical EU taxonomy (ENISA TIG §5) so every NIS 2 regulated entity can satisfy CIR §5.1.4 from a single source.

privacy.heading: Bilateral and private.
privacy.body: Built in Germany, hosted in the EU, aligned with BSI Grundschutz. Your data is shared only with customers you explicitly invite. No public URL, no search-engine indexing.

cta.heading: Start in two minutes.
cta.body: Sign in with Google. Enter company name and primary domain. Fill the questionnaire at your own pace. When you are ready, invite your customers.

related.heading: Continue on nisd2.eu.
related.lead: This tool is part of the nisd2.eu ecosystem. The rest lives here.
